validation.existing_owner_baseline: passed including historical, cache and auth tests

deployment_failure.stage: Foundation Workers services API, before upload
deployment_failure.required_access: Workers Admin to create a new Worker, or Workers Editor on an existing Worker

protocol.auth: HMAC-SHA256, Unix expiry caller+30s, receiver max60s
protocol.public_auth: unchanged; owner KV and positive cache
protocol.source_body: native JS streams; JSON decode only on owner

metrics.foundation_native_r2: separate confirmed attempts, bytes and successes
metrics.reader_http: separate attempts; failure can leave backend work unknown

limits: Local workerd tests prove the protocol and bytes, not Cloudflare network latency.
Cross-account calls still use HTTPS; there is no supported cross-account service binding in this setup.
At marginal Standard rates, two reader HTTP calls add two Worker invocations; R2 GET fees remain.
The live same-block Helius comparison cannot be measured until Foundation deployment access is available.
